name: Async Hotbars
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: xpncvr
description: Minecraft mod that reduces brief hotbar lag by handling large item data asynchronously, preventing client freezes when saving or opening the creative saved item hotbar. Fixes freeze stutter when saving hotbars.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3)
